_comment: Perft reference numbers, frozen by tools/perft_freeze.py. Production and reference engines agree exactly at every listed depth (§2.3).
_semantics: perft(s, 0) = 1; a terminal position at depth >= 1 counts 0. Positions are FENs: ranks 8->1, side to move, ply count.
